WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    p.bats as batting_hand,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM appearances a
  JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.bats
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as total_count,
    AVG(CAST(count AS FLOAT)) as avg_count
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT 
  g.batting_hand,
  g.count,
  CAST(g.count AS FLOAT) / s.total_count as share,
  CAST(g.count AS FLOAT) / s.avg_count as count_div_avg
FROM grouped g
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE s.total_count IS NOT NULL
  AND s.avg_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY g.batting_hand
